title: Paul Otlet, visioning a web in 1934
summary: A one-minute clip about Paul Otlet, the Belgian bibliographer who in 1934 imagined users accessing a remote database through an electric telescope over a phone line. It presents his vision as a precursor of the web.
why: Brought up whenever early predictions of the internet and the web's origins are discussed.

quote.text: I always have to mention Paul Otlet, when the topic of early predictions of technology comes up.
